wiki-curator.description: Maintains compact project memory in agent-wiki/wiki and structured registries in agent-wiki/knowledge.

context-curator.description: Load the agent-wiki curator context pack.
context-curator.template:
Use this agent-wiki curator context pack as startup context:

!`python agent-wiki/scripts/wiki/contextualize.py --role wiki-curator --project-root . --no-git --max-lines 180`

Review only routed evidence and keep agent-wiki/wiki compact.

wiki-lint.description: Run the agent-wiki lint gate and explain failures.
wiki-lint.template:
Run and interpret the agent-wiki lint gate:

!`python agent-wiki/scripts/wiki/lint.py`

If it fails, explain the exact issue and propose or apply the smallest fix.

wiki-scan.description: Record a curator handoff from current host-project git changes.
wiki-scan.template:
Record and summarize a curator handoff:

!`python agent-wiki/scripts/wiki/scan_changes.py --project-root . --summary 'OpenCode wiki-scan handoff.'`

Explain which routes the curator should inspect and whether current truth may have changed.

wiki-map.description: Regenerate agent-wiki/wiki/PROJECT_MAP.md from the host project tree.
wiki-map.template:
Regenerate the host-project map and summarize structural changes:

!`python agent-wiki/scripts/wiki/build_tree.py --project-root .`

Then inspect agent-wiki/wiki/PROJECT_MAP.md if needed and note whether routing should change.

wiki-rollover.description: Check active wiki logs for rollover.
wiki-rollover.template:
Check active logs for rollover:

!`python agent-wiki/scripts/wiki/rollover_logs.py --threshold 800`

If rollover is needed, summarize which logs should close or archive.
